literal_meaning: গর্জন বা উচ্চারিত শব্দের অনুকরণ (onomatopoeic reduplication for rumbling or murmuring sound)
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicated expression indicating the sensation of pushing and crowding due to lack of space, often referring to stomach discomfort from undigested food
example_sentences_in_english: The food is still rumbling in my stomach.
Everyone started grumbling in the crowd.
note: Primarily onomatopoeic for rumbling sounds; used metaphorically for physical or social crowding/discomfort in Bengali vernacular.
